sample_design: Three independent fresh jobs per runner size, launched in one matrix run
primary_metric: GitHub Actions duration of Run tests with coverage, in seconds
secondary_metrics: Matched checkout, tool installation, dependency sync, preflight and full-suite step durations
Full job duration including benchmark instrumentation and artifact upload
Test identities, outcomes, coverage, actual CPU counts and worker counts
Whether full-suite duration exceeds production's 900-second timeout
controls: All checkouts use the same unmodified production source revision
Setup action versions and three workload commands match production CI
Preserve pytest -n auto so worker count reflects the proposed runner change
Record requested and actual CPU counts, memory, image and tool versions
Use the production cache configuration and record cache outcomes from job logs
Check external blueprint HEAD before and after every sample; reject changed refs
Compare test identities and outcomes before interpreting timings

cost_model.qualification: Published-rate estimate before free credits, discounts and billing rounding

decision_scope: Report measurements and a recommendation; retain production CI runner until the user decides
